baseline: 8px. Every gap, pad and offset is a multiple. --space-half (4px) is the sole exception, for optical alignment against a 1px hairline.

archive.use: Editorial and print. Fichas, posters, packaging, the folio system. Generous negative space.

field.use: Reports, labels, lot records, SOPs. Touch targets >= 44px. Default mode.

control.use: Dense telemetry. Dashboards, metric tables, room monitors. Monospace tabular data.

culinary.use: Culinary market and packaging previews. Editorial breathing room with web-safe commercial density.

structure.shadow: none — the only legal value. Depth is expressed with frames and rules, never blur.

component.description: Fixed component measurements. Consumed as CSS variables; never repeat these literals in components/.
